job_text:
Public Relations Manager
----------------------------------------
We are seeking a strategic and creative Public Relations Manager to develop and execute comprehensive PR strategies that enhance brand reputation, manage media relationships, and drive positive public perception. This role requires a communications professional who can craft compelling narratives, secure media coverage, manage crisis communications, and coordinate integrated PR campaigns. You will be responsible for media relations, press release development, event coordination, social media strategy, and reputation management while serving as primary spokesperson for organizational communications. The ideal candidate will have exceptional writing and storytelling abilities, strong media contacts, crisis management experience, and proven track record securing meaningful media placements.
----------------------------------------
* Bachelor's degree in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, or related field; Master's degree preferred
* Minimum 6-8 years of public relations experience with proven track record securing meaningful media coverage for organizations or clients
* Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills with portfolio demonstrating press releases, pitch letters, and published placements
* Established relationships with media contacts across relevant beats including business, technology, lifestyle, or industry-specific journalists
* Strong understanding of media landscape, editorial calendars, newsroom operations, and what makes stories newsworthy
* Experience developing and executing crisis communication strategies and managing sensitive communications situations
* Proven ability to develop strategic PR campaigns that achieve measurable results and support business objectives
* Excellent verbal communication and presentation skills for media interviews, executive briefings, and stakeholder presentations
* Strong relationship-building abilities with talent for establishing trust with journalists, influencers, and key stakeholders
* Experience with media monitoring and PR measurement tools such as Cision, Meltwater, or similar platforms
* Understanding of digital PR including blogger outreach, online reputation management, and earned media in digital channels
* Strategic thinking capabilities with ability to identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and develop proactive communication strategies
* Strong project management skills with ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously
* Experience working with C-level executives, preparing messaging, and providing media coaching
* Knowledge of industry regulations, ethical standards, and best practices governing public relations activities
* Flexibility to respond to media inquiries and manage issues outside standard business hours when necessary
----------------------------------------
* Develop and implement comprehensive public relations strategies aligned with organizational objectives, brand positioning, and communication goals
* Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors, bloggers, and media outlets across print, broadcast, and digital platforms
* Write, edit, and distribute press releases, media advisories, pitch letters, and other media materials that generate coverage and tell compelling stories
* Secure media placements and interviews in target publications and outlets, pitching story ideas and facilitating journalist access to organizational spokespeople
* Monitor media coverage and public sentiment, tracking mentions, analyzing coverage tone, and providing regular reports to leadership
* Develop and implement crisis communication plans, serving as primary communications contact during issues or negative situations to protect organizational reputation
* Coordinate press conferences, media briefings, and press events including logistics, materials preparation, and spokesperson coaching
* Train executives and spokespeople on media interview techniques, message development, and effective communication strategies
* Collaborate with marketing, social media, and content teams to ensure consistent messaging across all communication channels
* Create thought leadership opportunities through op-eds, bylined articles, speaking engagements, and industry panel participation
* Manage PR agency relationships if applicable, providing direction, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring alignment with organizational priorities
* Develop content for corporate communications including executive communications, employee newsletters, and stakeholder updates
* Plan and coordinate corporate events, community engagement activities, and sponsorship activations that enhance brand visibility
* Measure and report on PR performance using metrics including media impressions, share of voice, sentiment analysis, and campaign effectiveness

job_text:
Public Relations Manager
----------------------------------------
We are seeking a strategic and creative Public Relations Manager to develop and execute comprehensive PR strategies that enhance brand reputation, manage media relationships, and drive positive public perception. This role requires a communications professional who can craft compelling narratives, secure media coverage, manage crisis communications, and coordinate integrated PR campaigns. You will be responsible for media relations, press release development, event coordination, social media strategy, and reputation management while serving as primary spokesperson for organizational communications. The ideal candidate will have exceptional writing and storytelling abilities, strong media contacts, crisis management experience, and proven track record securing meaningful media placements.
----------------------------------------
* Bachelor's degree in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, or related field; Master's degree preferred
* Minimum 6-8 years of public relations experience with proven track record securing meaningful media coverage for organizations or clients
* Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills with portfolio demonstrating press releases, pitch letters, and published placements
* Established relationships with media contacts across relevant beats including business, technology, lifestyle, or industry-specific journalists
* Strong understanding of media landscape, editorial calendars, newsroom operations, and what makes stories newsworthy
* Experience developing and executing crisis communication strategies and managing sensitive communications situations
* Proven ability to develop strategic PR campaigns that achieve measurable results and support business objectives
* Excellent verbal communication and presentation skills for media interviews, executive briefings, and stakeholder presentations
* Strong relationship-building abilities with talent for establishing trust with journalists, influencers, and key stakeholders
* Experience with media monitoring and PR measurement tools such as Cision, Meltwater, or similar platforms
* Understanding of digital PR including blogger outreach, online reputation management, and earned media in digital channels
* Strategic thinking capabilities with ability to identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and develop proactive communication strategies
* Strong project management skills with ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously
* Experience working with C-level executives, preparing messaging, and providing media coaching
* Knowledge of industry regulations, ethical standards, and best practices governing public relations activities
* Flexibility to respond to media inquiries and manage issues outside standard business hours when necessary
----------------------------------------
* Develop and implement comprehensive public relations strategies aligned with organizational objectives, brand positioning, and communication goals
* Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors, bloggers, and media outlets across print, broadcast, and digital platforms
* Write, edit, and distribute press releases, media advisories, pitch letters, and other media materials that generate coverage and tell compelling stories
* Secure media placements and interviews in target publications and outlets, pitching story ideas and facilitating journalist access to organizational spokespeople
* Monitor media coverage and public sentiment, tracking mentions, analyzing coverage tone, and providing regular reports to leadership
* Develop and implement crisis communication plans, serving as primary communications contact during issues or negative situations to protect organizational reputation
* Coordinate press conferences, media briefings, and press events including logistics, materials preparation, and spokesperson coaching
* Train executives and spokespeople on media interview techniques, message development, and effective communication strategies
* Collaborate with marketing, social media, and content teams to ensure consistent messaging across all communication channels
* Create thought leadership opportunities through op-eds, bylined articles, speaking engagements, and industry panel participation
* Manage PR agency relationships if applicable, providing direction, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring alignment with organizational priorities
* Develop content for corporate communications including executive communications, employee newsletters, and stakeholder updates
* Plan and coordinate corporate events, community engagement activities, and sponsorship activations that enhance brand visibility
* Measure and report on PR performance using metrics including media impressions, share of voice, sentiment analysis, and campaign effectiveness

* Lead complex sales cycles from prospecting and qualification through proposal development, negotiation, and contract closure
* Develop compelling value propositions, presentations, and proposals that articulate company capabilities and differentiate from competitors
* Conduct comprehensive market research and competitive analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and threats in target markets
* Collaborate with marketing, product, and operations teams to develop go-to-market strategies, positioning, and sales enablement materials
* Negotiate high-value contracts and partnership agreements, ensuring favorable terms while building long-term mutually beneficial relationships
* Manage strategic accounts and key client relationships, ensuring exceptional service delivery, identifying upsell opportunities, and driving account growth
* Develop accurate sales forecasts, pipeline reports, and business performance metrics, providing regular updates to executive leadership
* Build, lead, and mentor business development team members, setting clear objectives, providing coaching, and fostering professional growth
* Represent company at industry conferences, trade shows, networking events, and speaking engagements to enhance brand visibility and generate leads
* Establish and track key performance indicators for business development activities, analyzing data to optimize strategies and improve results
* Collaborate with finance and legal teams on pricing strategies, contract terms, risk assessment, and deal structuring for complex opportunities

job_text:
Public Relations Manager
----------------------------------------
We are seeking a strategic and creative Public Relations Manager to develop and execute comprehensive PR strategies that enhance brand reputation, manage media relationships, and drive positive public perception. This role requires a communications professional who can craft compelling narratives, secure media coverage, manage crisis communications, and coordinate integrated PR campaigns. You will be responsible for media relations, press release development, event coordination, social media strategy, and reputation management while serving as primary spokesperson for organizational communications. The ideal candidate will have exceptional writing and storytelling abilities, strong media contacts, crisis management experience, and proven track record securing meaningful media placements.
----------------------------------------
* Bachelor's degree in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, or related field; Master's degree preferred
* Minimum 6-8 years of public relations experience with proven track record securing meaningful media coverage for organizations or clients
* Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills with portfolio demonstrating press releases, pitch letters, and published placements
* Established relationships with media contacts across relevant beats including business, technology, lifestyle, or industry-specific journalists
* Strong understanding of media landscape, editorial calendars, newsroom operations, and what makes stories newsworthy
* Experience developing and executing crisis communication strategies and managing sensitive communications situations
* Proven ability to develop strategic PR campaigns that achieve measurable results and support business objectives
* Excellent verbal communication and presentation skills for media interviews, executive briefings, and stakeholder presentations
* Strong relationship-building abilities with talent for establishing trust with journalists, influencers, and key stakeholders
* Experience with media monitoring and PR measurement tools such as Cision, Meltwater, or similar platforms
* Understanding of digital PR including blogger outreach, online reputation management, and earned media in digital channels
* Strategic thinking capabilities with ability to identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and develop proactive communication strategies
* Strong project management skills with ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously
* Experience working with C-level executives, preparing messaging, and providing media coaching
* Knowledge of industry regulations, ethical standards, and best practices governing public relations activities
* Flexibility to respond to media inquiries and manage issues outside standard business hours when necessary
----------------------------------------
* Develop and implement comprehensive public relations strategies aligned with organizational objectives, brand positioning, and communication goals
* Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors, bloggers, and media outlets across print, broadcast, and digital platforms
* Write, edit, and distribute press releases, media advisories, pitch letters, and other media materials that generate coverage and tell compelling stories
* Secure media placements and interviews in target publications and outlets, pitching story ideas and facilitating journalist access to organizational spokespeople
* Monitor media coverage and public sentiment, tracking mentions, analyzing coverage tone, and providing regular reports to leadership
* Develop and implement crisis communication plans, serving as primary communications contact during issues or negative situations to protect organizational reputation
* Coordinate press conferences, media briefings, and press events including logistics, materials preparation, and spokesperson coaching
* Train executives and spokespeople on media interview techniques, message development, and effective communication strategies
* Collaborate with marketing, social media, and content teams to ensure consistent messaging across all communication channels
* Create thought leadership opportunities through op-eds, bylined articles, speaking engagements, and industry panel participation
* Manage PR agency relationships if applicable, providing direction, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring alignment with organizational priorities
* Develop content for corporate communications including executive communications, employee newsletters, and stakeholder updates
* Plan and coordinate corporate events, community engagement activities, and sponsorship activations that enhance brand visibility
* Measure and report on PR performance using metrics including media impressions, share of voice, sentiment analysis, and campaign effectiveness

----------------------------------------
We are seeking an experienced Human Resources Business Partner to serve as a strategic advisor to leadership teams while managing the full employee lifecycle. This role requires a dynamic professional who can balance strategic HR initiatives with hands-on operational support, fostering a positive workplace culture and driving organizational effectiveness. You will work closely with department heads to align HR strategies with business objectives, manage talent acquisition and retention programs, and ensure compliance with employment laws and regulations. ----------------------------------------
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field; Master's degree or MBA preferred
* Minimum 5-7 years of progressive HR experience with at least 3 years in a business partner or strategic HR role

* Strong problem-solving and critical thinking abilities with a solutions-oriented mindset
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and maintain high ethical standards
* Experience leading change management initiatives and supporting organizations through periods of transformation
* Project management skills with ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously

* Manage employee relations issues by conducting thorough investigations, providing coaching to managers, mediating conflicts, and recommending appropriate solutions
* Develop and maintain compensation and benefits programs that are competitive, equitable, and aligned with organizational budget and market standards

* Analyze HR metrics and workforce data to identify trends, develop insights, and make data-driven recommendations to leadership
* Lead organizational change management initiatives including restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, and cultural transformation projects
* Develop and implement employee engagement strategies including surveys, feedback mechanisms, recognition programs, and retention initiatives

Commercial Banking Relationship Manager
----------------------------------------
We are seeking an experienced Commercial Banking Relationship Manager to develop and manage a portfolio of commercial banking clients, providing comprehensive financial solutions and exceptional relationship management. This role requires a banking professional who can identify business needs, structure financing solutions, cross-sell banking products, and serve as trusted financial advisor to middle-market companies. You will be responsible for business development, credit analysis, loan structuring, portfolio management, and delivering superior client service. The ideal candidate will have strong commercial banking knowledge, proven sales abilities, excellent credit judgment, and talent for building lasting client relationships that drive profitability and portfolio growth.
----------------------------------------
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or related field; MBA preferred
* Minimum 5-8 years of commercial banking, business banking, or corporate lending experience with proven track record of portfolio growth
* Strong credit analysis and financial statement interpretation skills with ability to assess business creditworthiness and structure appropriate financing
* Comprehensive knowledge of commercial loan products, treasury management solutions, and banking services for business clients
* Proven business development abilities with demonstrated success generating new commercial banking relationships and meeting production goals
* Excellent relationship management skills with talent for understanding client needs, building trust, and serving as strategic financial advisor
* Strong understanding of various industries, business models, and financial structures affecting commercial borrowers
* Ability to structure complex transactions and negotiate deal terms that balance client satisfaction with appropriate risk and return
* Proficiency with commercial loan documentation, credit agreement covenants, and lending legal requirements
* Knowledge of regulatory environment affecting commercial lending including bank regulations, compliance requirements, and lending limits
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills for client meetings, credit presentations, and internal collaboration
* Strong organizational abilities with capacity to manage diverse portfolio of clients with varying needs and risk profiles
* Established network within local business community preferred; willingness to actively build professional networks and visibility
* Proficiency with loan origination systems, credit analysis tools, and banking platforms
* Series 6, 7, or 63 securities licenses beneficial for wealth management referrals but not required
* Flexibility to attend client meetings, networking events, and business functions outside traditional banking hours as needed
----------------------------------------
* Develop and manage portfolio of commercial banking relationships with annual revenues typically ranging from $5M to $100M across diverse industries
* Prospect for new business through networking, referrals, cold calling, and community involvement, building pipeline of qualified commercial banking opportunities
* Conduct comprehensive needs assessments with business owners and financial decision-makers, understanding business operations, financial position, and banking needs
* Structure and recommend appropriate commercial lending solutions including lines of credit, term loans, commercial real estate financing, and equipment financing
* Perform financial analysis and credit underwriting, reviewing financial statements, tax returns, collateral, and business plans to assess creditworthiness and risk
* Prepare detailed credit memorandums and loan presentations for credit approval, articulating deal structure, repayment sources, collateral, and risk mitigation
* Cross-sell comprehensive banking products and services including treasury management, merchant services, wealth management, and employee benefit programs
* Monitor portfolio performance through regular client contact, financial statement reviews, and site visits, proactively identifying and addressing potential issues
* Maintain compliance with bank policies, regulatory requirements, and credit administration procedures throughout loan origination and portfolio management
* Build and leverage professional networks through chamber memberships, trade associations, industry events, and community leadership roles
* Collaborate with treasury management, credit administration, operations, and other internal partners to deliver seamless client service and solutions
* Stay informed about economic conditions, industry trends, and competitive offerings affecting commercial banking clients and opportunities
* Meet or exceed annual goals for loan production, portfolio growth, fee income generation, and new relationship development
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions for credit facilities while balancing client needs with bank profitability and risk objectives

Financial Controller
----------------------------------------
We are seeking an experienced Financial Controller to oversee all accounting operations, financial reporting, and internal controls while providing strategic financial leadership to the organization. This senior role requires a detail-oriented financial professional who can manage accounting teams, ensure accurate financial statements, implement robust controls, and provide insightful analysis to support business decisions. You will be responsible for month-end close processes, budgeting and forecasting, audit coordination, compliance management, and continuous improvement of financial systems and processes. The ideal candidate will have strong technical accounting knowledge, proven leadership abilities, exceptional analytical skills, and strategic mindset to partner effectively with executive leadership.
----------------------------------------
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required; MBA or Master's in Accounting preferred
* CPA certification required; CMA or other relevant professional certifications beneficial
* Minimum 8-10 years of progressive accounting experience with at least 4-5 years in controller or senior accounting management role
* Deep knowledge of GAAP, financial reporting standards, and regulatory compliance requirements
* Proven experience managing complete accounting cycle, preparing financial statements, and coordinating external audits
* Strong understanding of internal controls, SOX compliance, and risk management practices
* Expert proficiency with accounting systems (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar ERP platforms) and advanced Excel skills
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with talent for translating complex financial data into clear insights
* Strong leadership and team management skills with ability to build, develop, and retain high-performing accounting teams
* Experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and variance analysis processes
* Knowledge of tax accounting, transfer pricing, and multi-entity/multi-jurisdictional accounting preferred
* Exceptional attention to detail with commitment to accuracy and quality in all financial reporting and analysis
* Strong business acumen with ability to partner effectively with operations and provide strategic financial guidance
* Excellent communication and presentation skills for reporting to executives, board members, and external stakeholders
* Experience with IPO preparation, SEC reporting, or public company accounting beneficial for growth-stage companies
* Ability to thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments and manage multiple priorities with tight deadlines
----------------------------------------
* Oversee all accounting operations including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, payroll, fixed assets, and cash management
* Manage month-end and year-end close processes, ensuring timely and accurate completion of financial statements in accordance with GAAP
* Prepare consolidated financial statements, management reports, variance analyses, and executive dashboards for senior leadership and board of directors
* Lead annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting processes, working with department heads to develop realistic plans aligned with strategic objectives
* Develop and maintain robust internal control framework to safeguard company assets, ensure accuracy of financial records, and prevent fraud
* Coordinate external audit activities, preparing audit schedules, responding to auditor requests, and ensuring smooth audit process and clean opinions
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements, tax filings, statutory reporting, and financial covenants for debt agreements
* Implement and optimize financial systems, accounting software, and reporting tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, and analytical capabilities
* Manage and develop accounting team including accountants, financial analysts, and accounts payable/receivable staff, providing mentorship and professional development
* Analyze financial performance, identify trends and variances, and provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve profitability and efficiency
* Develop and monitor key performance indicators and financial metrics to track business performance against goals and industry benchmarks
* Oversee cash flow management, working capital optimization, and liquidity planning to ensure adequate funding for operational needs
* Support strategic initiatives including financial modeling for investments, acquisitions, new ventures, and major capital expenditures
* Establish and document accounting policies, procedures, and controls to ensure consistent application of accounting principles

Culinary Chef de Cuisine
----------------------------------------
We are seeking a talented and passionate Culinary Chef de Cuisine to lead our kitchen operations and create exceptional dining experiences through innovative cuisine and culinary excellence. This senior leadership role requires a skilled culinary professional who can oversee menu development, manage kitchen staff, maintain food quality standards, and drive operational efficiency. You will be responsible for creating innovative dishes, managing food costs, ensuring health and safety compliance, and leading a high-performing culinary team. The ideal candidate will have extensive culinary expertise, proven leadership abilities, creative vision, and unwavering commitment to culinary excellence and guest satisfaction.
----------------------------------------
* Culinary degree from accredited culinary school or equivalent combination of formal culinary training and professional experience
* Minimum 8-10 years of professional culinary experience with at least 3-5 years in executive chef or chef de cuisine role
* Extensive knowledge of classical and contemporary cooking techniques, international cuisines, and modern culinary trends
* Proven track record of menu development, recipe creation, and culinary innovation in upscale dining environments
* Strong leadership and team management skills with ability to inspire, motivate, and develop diverse culinary teams
* Comprehensive understanding of food cost management, inventory control, and kitchen financial operations
* Expert knowledge of food safety regulations, HACCP principles, and health department requirements
* Excellent palate with refined sense of flavor profiles, seasoning, and ability to create balanced, memorable dishes
* Strong organizational and time management skills with ability to manage high-volume service and multiple stations simultaneously
* Experience with various dietary requirements including vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and allergen considerations
* Proficiency with kitchen management software, ordering systems, and inventory tracking applications
* Creativity and artistic vision for menu development, dish presentation, and culinary storytelling
* Physical stamina to work long hours standing, in hot environments, and performing physically demanding kitchen tasks
* Strong communication skills for effective interaction with kitchen staff, service team, management, and occasionally guests
* ServSafe Manager certification or equivalent food safety certification required
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and adjust schedule based on restaurant operational needs
----------------------------------------
* Design and develop innovative, seasonal menus that reflect culinary trends, showcase local ingredients, and align with restaurant concept and guest preferences
* Oversee all kitchen operations including food preparation, cooking, plating, and quality control to ensure consistent excellence in every dish
* Lead, mentor, and develop kitchen team including sous chefs, line cooks, and prep cooks, providing training, feedback, and career development opportunities
* Create standardized recipes with detailed specifications for ingredients, portions, preparation methods, and presentation to ensure consistency

job_text:
Culinary Chef de Cuisine
----------------------------------------
We are seeking a talented and passionate Culinary Chef de Cuisine to lead our kitchen operations and create exceptional dining experiences through innovative cuisine and culinary excellence. This senior leadership role requires a skilled culinary professional who can oversee menu development, manage kitchen staff, maintain food quality standards, and drive operational efficiency. You will be responsible for creating innovative dishes, managing food costs, ensuring health and safety compliance, and leading a high-performing culinary team. The ideal candidate will have extensive culinary expertise, proven leadership abilities, creative vision, and unwavering commitment to culinary excellence and guest satisfaction.
----------------------------------------
* Culinary degree from accredited culinary school or equivalent combination of formal culinary training and professional experience
* Minimum 8-10 years of professional culinary experience with at least 3-5 years in executive chef or chef de cuisine role
* Extensive knowledge of classical and contemporary cooking techniques, international cuisines, and modern culinary trends
* Proven track record of menu development, recipe creation, and culinary innovation in upscale dining environments
* Strong leadership and team management skills with ability to inspire, motivate, and develop diverse culinary teams
* Comprehensive understanding of food cost management, inventory control, and kitchen financial operations
* Expert knowledge of food safety regulations, HACCP principles, and health department requirements
* Excellent palate with refined sense of flavor profiles, seasoning, and ability to create balanced, memorable dishes
* Strong organizational and time management skills with ability to manage high-volume service and multiple stations simultaneously
* Experience with various dietary requirements including vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and allergen considerations
* Proficiency with kitchen management software, ordering systems, and inventory tracking applications
* Creativity and artistic vision for menu development, dish presentation, and culinary storytelling
* Physical stamina to work long hours standing, in hot environments, and performing physically demanding kitchen tasks
* Strong communication skills for effective interaction with kitchen staff, service team, management, and occasionally guests
* ServSafe Manager certification or equivalent food safety certification required
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and adjust schedule based on restaurant operational needs
----------------------------------------
* Design and develop innovative, seasonal menus that reflect culinary trends, showcase local ingredients, and align with restaurant concept and guest preferences
* Oversee all kitchen operations including food preparation, cooking, plating, and quality control to ensure consistent excellence in every dish
* Lead, mentor, and develop kitchen team including sous chefs, line cooks, and prep cooks, providing training, feedback, and career development opportunities
* Create standardized recipes with detailed specifications for ingredients, portions, preparation methods, and presentation to ensure consistency
* Manage food ordering, inventory control, and supplier relationships to ensure quality ingredients while optimizing food costs and minimizing waste
* Develop and manage kitchen budget, monitor food costs, labor expenses, and operational costs to achieve financial targets and profitability goals
* Ensure strict adherence to food safety standards, sanitation protocols, and health department regulations, maintaining safe and clean kitchen environment
* Coordinate with front-of-house management to ensure seamless service execution, address guest feedback, and accommodate special dietary requirements
* Conduct regular tastings and quality checks throughout service to maintain high standards for flavor, temperature, texture, and presentation
* Stay current on culinary trends, new cooking techniques, ingredient innovations, and competitive restaurant offerings to maintain creative edge
* Manage kitchen equipment maintenance, ensuring proper functioning, scheduling repairs, and implementing preventive maintenance programs
* Develop and implement systems for efficient kitchen workflow, station organization, and service timing to optimize productivity during peak periods
* Collaborate with restaurant management on special events, wine pairings, tasting menus, and promotional offerings
* Train staff on proper food handling, knife skills, cooking techniques, and presentation standards to elevate overall team capabilities

job_text:
Culinary Chef de Cuisine
----------------------------------------
We are seeking a talented and passionate Culinary Chef de Cuisine to lead our kitchen operations and create exceptional dining experiences through innovative cuisine and culinary excellence. This senior leadership role requires a skilled culinary professional who can oversee menu development, manage kitchen staff, maintain food quality standards, and drive operational efficiency. You will be responsible for creating innovative dishes, managing food costs, ensuring health and safety compliance, and leading a high-performing culinary team. The ideal candidate will have extensive culinary expertise, proven leadership abilities, creative vision, and unwavering commitment to culinary excellence and guest satisfaction.
----------------------------------------
* Culinary degree from accredited culinary school or equivalent combination of formal culinary training and professional experience
* Minimum 8-10 years of professional culinary experience with at least 3-5 years in executive chef or chef de cuisine role
* Extensive knowledge of classical and contemporary cooking techniques, international cuisines, and modern culinary trends
* Proven track record of menu development, recipe creation, and culinary innovation in upscale dining environments
* Strong leadership and team management skills with ability to inspire, motivate, and develop diverse culinary teams
* Comprehensive understanding of food cost management, inventory control, and kitchen financial operations
* Expert knowledge of food safety regulations, HACCP principles, and health department requirements
* Excellent palate with refined sense of flavor profiles, seasoning, and ability to create balanced, memorable dishes
* Strong organizational and time management skills with ability to manage high-volume service and multiple stations simultaneously
* Experience with various dietary requirements including vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and allergen considerations
* Proficiency with kitchen management software, ordering systems, and inventory tracking applications
* Creativity and artistic vision for menu development, dish presentation, and culinary storytelling
* Physical stamina to work long hours standing, in hot environments, and performing physically demanding kitchen tasks
* Strong communication skills for effective interaction with kitchen staff, service team, management, and occasionally guests
* ServSafe Manager certification or equivalent food safety certification required
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and adjust schedule based on restaurant operational needs
----------------------------------------
* Design and develop innovative, seasonal menus that reflect culinary trends, showcase local ingredients, and align with restaurant concept and guest preferences
* Oversee all kitchen operations including food preparation, cooking, plating, and quality control to ensure consistent excellence in every dish
* Lead, mentor, and develop kitchen team including sous chefs, line cooks, and prep cooks, providing training, feedback, and career development opportunities
* Create standardized recipes with detailed specifications for ingredients, portions, preparation methods, and presentation to ensure consistency
* Manage food ordering, inventory control, and supplier relationships to ensure quality ingredients while optimizing food costs and minimizing waste
* Develop and manage kitchen budget, monitor food costs, labor expenses, and operational costs to achieve financial targets and profitability goals
* Ensure strict adherence to food safety standards, sanitation protocols, and health department regulations, maintaining safe and clean kitchen environment
* Coordinate with front-of-house management to ensure seamless service execution, address guest feedback, and accommodate special dietary requirements
* Conduct regular tastings and quality checks throughout service to maintain high standards for flavor, temperature, texture, and presentation
* Stay current on culinary trends, new cooking techniques, ingredient innovations, and competitive restaurant offerings to maintain creative edge
* Manage kitchen equipment maintenance, ensuring proper functioning, scheduling repairs, and implementing preventive maintenance programs
* Develop and implement systems for efficient kitchen workflow, station organization, and service timing to optimize productivity during peak periods
* Collaborate with restaurant management on special events, wine pairings, tasting menus, and promotional offerings
* Train staff on proper food handling, knife skills, cooking techniques, and presentation standards to elevate overall team capabilities

----------------------------------------

* Extensive knowledge of classical and contemporary cooking techniques, international cuisines, and modern culinary trends
* Proven track record of menu development, recipe creation, and culinary innovation in upscale dining environments
* Strong leadership and team management skills with ability to inspire, motivate, and develop diverse culinary teams
* Comprehensive understanding of food cost management, inventory control, and kitchen financial operations
* Expert knowledge of food safety regulations, HACCP principles, and health department requirements
* Excellent palate with refined sense of flavor profiles, seasoning, and ability to create balanced, memorable dishes
* Strong organizational and time management skills with ability to manage high-volume service and multiple stations simultaneously

* Proficiency with kitchen management software, ordering systems, and inventory tracking applications
* Creativity and artistic vision for menu development, dish presentation, and culinary storytelling
* Physical stamina to work long hours standing, in hot environments, and performing physically demanding kitchen tasks

* ServSafe Manager certification or equivalent food safety certification required
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and adjust schedule based on restaurant operational needs

* Develop and manage kitchen budget, monitor food costs, labor expenses, and operational costs to achieve financial targets and profitability goals
* Ensure strict adherence to food safety standards, sanitation protocols, and health department regulations, maintaining safe and clean kitchen environment
* Coordinate with front-of-house management to ensure seamless service execution, address guest feedback, and accommodate special dietary requirements
* Conduct regular tastings and quality checks throughout service to maintain high standards for flavor, temperature, texture, and presentation
* Stay current on culinary trends, new cooking techniques, ingredient innovations, and competitive restaurant offerings to maintain creative edge
* Manage kitchen equipment maintenance, ensuring proper functioning, scheduling repairs, and implementing preventive maintenance programs
* Develop and implement systems for efficient kitchen workflow, station organization, and service timing to optimize productivity during peak periods
* Collaborate with restaurant management on special events, wine pairings, tasting menus, and promotional offerings
* Train staff on proper food handling, knife skills, cooking techniques, and presentation standards to elevate overall team capabilities

Human Resources Business Partner
----------------------------------------
We are seeking an experienced Human Resources Business Partner to serve as a strategic advisor to leadership teams while managing the full employee lifecycle. This role requires a dynamic professional who can balance strategic HR initiatives with hands-on operational support, fostering a positive workplace culture and driving organizational effectiveness. You will work closely with department heads to align HR strategies with business objectives, manage talent acquisition and retention programs, and ensure compliance with employment laws and regulations. The ideal candidate will have exceptional interpersonal skills, strong business acumen, and the ability to influence at all levels of the organization.
----------------------------------------
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field; Master's degree or MBA preferred
* Minimum 5-7 years of progressive HR experience with at least 3 years in a business partner or strategic HR role
* Professional HR certification such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR strongly preferred
* Deep knowledge of employment law, HR best practices, and current trends in talent management and organizational development
* Proven experience managing full-cycle recruitment processes and building effective talent acquisition strategies
* Strong business acumen with ability to understand financial statements, business models, and organizational dynamics
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with ability to build trust and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels
* Demonstrated experience with HRIS systems and HR analytics tools; proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite required
* Strong problem-solving and critical thinking abilities with a solutions-oriented mindset
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and maintain high ethical standards
* Experience leading change management initiatives and supporting organizations through periods of transformation
* Project management skills with ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously
----------------------------------------
* Partner with business leaders to understand organizational goals and develop HR strategies that support achievement of business objectives
* Lead talent acquisition efforts including workforce planning, recruitment strategy development, candidate screening, interviewing, and onboarding processes
* Design and implement comprehensive employee development programs including training initiatives, succession planning, and career progression frameworks
* Manage employee relations issues by conducting thorough investigations, providing coaching to managers, mediating conflicts, and recommending appropriate solutions
* Develop and maintain compensation and benefits programs that are competitive, equitable, and aligned with organizational budget and market standards
* Drive performance management processes including goal setting, mid-year reviews, annual evaluations, and performance improvement plans
* Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations including FMLA, ADA, FLSA, and EEO requirements
* Analyze HR metrics and workforce data to identify trends, develop insights, and make data-driven recommendations to leadership
* Lead organizational change management initiatives including restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, and cultural transformation projects
* Develop and implement employee engagement strategies including surveys, feedback mechanisms, recognition programs, and retention initiatives

job_text:
Public Relations Manager
----------------------------------------
We are seeking a strategic and creative Public Relations Manager to develop and execute comprehensive PR strategies that enhance brand reputation, manage media relationships, and drive positive public perception. This role requires a communications professional who can craft compelling narratives, secure media coverage, manage crisis communications, and coordinate integrated PR campaigns. You will be responsible for media relations, press release development, event coordination, social media strategy, and reputation management while serving as primary spokesperson for organizational communications. The ideal candidate will have exceptional writing and storytelling abilities, strong media contacts, crisis management experience, and proven track record securing meaningful media placements.
----------------------------------------
* Bachelor's degree in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, or related field; Master's degree preferred
* Minimum 6-8 years of public relations experience with proven track record securing meaningful media coverage for organizations or clients
* Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills with portfolio demonstrating press releases, pitch letters, and published placements
* Established relationships with media contacts across relevant beats including business, technology, lifestyle, or industry-specific journalists
* Strong understanding of media landscape, editorial calendars, newsroom operations, and what makes stories newsworthy
* Experience developing and executing crisis communication strategies and managing sensitive communications situations
* Proven ability to develop strategic PR campaigns that achieve measurable results and support business objectives
* Excellent verbal communication and presentation skills for media interviews, executive briefings, and stakeholder presentations
* Strong relationship-building abilities with talent for establishing trust with journalists, influencers, and key stakeholders
* Experience with media monitoring and PR measurement tools such as Cision, Meltwater, or similar platforms
* Understanding of digital PR including blogger outreach, online reputation management, and earned media in digital channels
* Strategic thinking capabilities with ability to identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and develop proactive communication strategies
* Strong project management skills with ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously
* Experience working with C-level executives, preparing messaging, and providing media coaching
* Knowledge of industry regulations, ethical standards, and best practices governing public relations activities
* Flexibility to respond to media inquiries and manage issues outside standard business hours when necessary
----------------------------------------
* Develop and implement comprehensive public relations strategies aligned with organizational objectives, brand positioning, and communication goals
* Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors, bloggers, and media outlets across print, broadcast, and digital platforms
* Write, edit, and distribute press releases, media advisories, pitch letters, and other media materials that generate coverage and tell compelling stories
* Secure media placements and interviews in target publications and outlets, pitching story ideas and facilitating journalist access to organizational spokespeople
* Monitor media coverage and public sentiment, tracking mentions, analyzing coverage tone, and providing regular reports to leadership
* Develop and implement crisis communication plans, serving as primary communications contact during issues or negative situations to protect organizational reputation
* Coordinate press conferences, media briefings, and press events including logistics, materials preparation, and spokesperson coaching
* Train executives and spokespeople on media interview techniques, message development, and effective communication strategies
* Collaborate with marketing, social media, and content teams to ensure consistent messaging across all communication channels
* Create thought leadership opportunities through op-eds, bylined articles, speaking engagements, and industry panel participation
* Manage PR agency relationships if applicable, providing direction, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring alignment with organizational priorities
* Develop content for corporate communications including executive communications, employee newsletters, and stakeholder updates
* Plan and coordinate corporate events, community engagement activities, and sponsorship activations that enhance brand visibility
* Measure and report on PR performance using metrics including media impressions, share of voice, sentiment analysis, and campaign effectiveness
